skills.name: Special Attack: Ode to Dawn - Radiant Turn
skills.desc:
When Remielle is in combat and her Floating Radiance reaches its maximum of 120, hold  after a Special Attack or EX Special Attack to enter Stance Shift. Switching characters while in Stance Shift causes Remielle to enter the Phase Flow state:
While in the Phase Flow state, Remielle acts autonomously to assist in combat. In this state, Floating Radiance is consumed over time, and some of her attacks apply Lumiflux Buildup to the target. When Floating Radiance is fully depleted or upon leaving combat, Remielle exits the Phase Flow state. Before exiting the Phase Flow state, Remielle cannot be actively switched in except via a Chain Attack.
If Remielle triggers 3 RefringeRefringeIf an enemy has Lumiflux Buildup, when they're about to be inflicted with an Anomaly, that Anomaly is Refringed. After being Refringed, the Anomaly's Anomaly Effect Strength is enhanced based on the provider's Refringe Coefficient, increasing the total DMG that Anomaly can deal. reactions in one Phase Flow state, or has at least 1 stored VoidflareVoidflareWhen a squad member triggers Remielle's Lumiflux Refringe reaction, Remielle generates Voidflare based on the enhanced Anomaly Effect Strength of that Attribute Anomaly after it has been Refringed. Up to the 3 most recently generated Voidflares can be stored. when Floating Radiance is fully depleted, Assist: Flower & Feather Dance becomes available, and her normal switch-in is unlocked. Assist: Flower & Feather Dance is automatically used on Remielle's next normal switch-in.
Upon entering the Phase Flow state, Remielle increases all squad members's DMG by X% for 60s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
When Remielle's Floating Radiance has reached its maximum of 120 and her Special Attack or EX Special Attack hits a Stunned enemy, she can also enter the Phase Flow state by switching characters during the Special Attack or EX Special Attack.
If no character is switched in after entering Stance Shift, Remielle uses a downward attack to return to the ground instead.

After the skill ends, apply 2 Lumiflux Buildup to enemies hit.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.desc:
Remielle's Refringe Coefficient is equal to 0.02% of her Anomaly Proficiency. If there are 3 Anomaly characters in the squad, her Refringe Coefficient increases by an additional 10%.
When Remielle triggers a RefringeRefringeIf an enemy has Lumiflux Buildup, when they're about to be inflicted with an Anomaly, that Anomaly is Refringed. DMG Bonus: Includes both non-Attribute DMG Bonus and Attribute DMG Bonus of the current Attribute Anomaly after it has been Refringed. Up to the 3 most recently generated Voidflares can be stored.

Based on the Anomaly Effect Strength of all stored Voidflares, deals Attribute Anomaly DMG to the enemy using the corresponding skill's DMG multiplier. This multiplier is further increased by X% of Remielle's Anomaly Proficiency.

When Floating Radiance is fully depleted, she exits the Phase Flow state. Before exiting the Phase Flow state, she cannot be actively switched in except through Chain Attacks. state or after using Basic Attack: Rainbow's End or Basic Attack: Fleeting Grace.

When there are 1/2/3 Anomaly characters in the squad, upon entering the battlefield, all squad members gain an ATK increase equal to 6%/12%/40% of Remielle's initial ATK, up to a maximum increase of 1,600 ATK. Remielle's Daze dealt while in the Phase FlowPhase FlowWhile in the Phase Flow state, Remielle acts autonomously to assist in combat. During this, some attacks can also apply Lumiflux Buildup to the target. While in the Phase Flow state, Floating Radiance is consumed over time. When Floating Radiance is fully depleted, she exits the Phase Flow state. Before exiting the Phase Flow state, she cannot be actively switched in except through Chain Attacks. state increases by 6%/12%/35%.
When applying Lumiflux Buildup to an enemy, Remielle also applies the Prismatic effect: All squad members' attacks against enemies with the Prismatic effect have 15% increased Anomaly Buildup Rate. Prismatic is removed when the enemy no longer has Lumiflux Buildup. After Prismatic is removed, the Anomaly Buildup Rate increase persists for an additional 8s.

cons.name: Naive Oath
cons.desc:
Upon entering the battlefield, Remielle gains 3 special Voidflares. In Investigation Zone mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s.

When using Assist: Flower & Feather Dance, she gains 200 Decibels. This effect can trigger once every 18s.
While Remielle is in the Phase Flow state, other squad members' Attribute Anomaly DMG increases by 10%.

cons.name: Fall Into the Noise
cons.desc:
Remielle's Lumiflux increases by 20%.
When an Anomaly character in the squad deals Anomaly DMG to an enemy affected by Prismatic, the attack ignores 15% of the target's DEF. This effect persists for an additional 8s after Prismatic ends.
While Remielle is in the Phase Flow state, the frequency at which she automatically attacks to apply Lumiflux to enemies increases.

After entering the battlefield and gaining 3 special Voidflares, if all Voidflares are consumed, she immediately gains the maximum number of special Voidflares again. This effect to regain special Voidflares is removed after being triggered once or when Remielle enters the Phase Flow state.

If the 4th hit of her Basic Attack lands against a target, Remielle gains 3 special Voidflares after the skill ends. Special Voidflares gained this way deal DMG equal to 25% of the special Voidflares gained upon entering the battlefield.
